slides.slide_title: Introduce s-clusters: sc sk sm sn sp st sw

content_payload.front_text: sc  sk  sm  sn  sp  st  sw

slides.teacher_cue: S-clusters: s followed by another consonant. Seven initial s-clusters. sc (scan, scar), sk (skip, skill), sm (smile, smoke), sn (snap, snow), sp (spin, sport), st (stem, stop), sw (swim, sweet). The s comes first — do not add a vowel before it.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all seven s-clusters without vowel insertion.
slides.correction_move: Drill each cluster. Key contrast: s-clusters begin with /s/, not a vowel. Korean learners may add a vowel before s-clusters (uh-stop, ih-swim). This is syllable structure interference.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel addition before the s — a common Korean interference pattern with s-initial clusters.
